_comment: GitHub MCP Server -- provides tools for issues, PRs, repos, actions, and code search.
This is GitHub's own server, hosted remotely. The old npm package
@modelcontextprotocol/server-github is deprecated on npm and moved out of the
modelcontextprotocol/servers repository; do not use it.
Requires: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable (a fine-grained token
scoped to the repositories you want Claude to work with).
Install: Copy the 'github' key into .mcp.json under mcpServers.
Or run: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN"
Tools are grouped into toolsets. The default toolsets are enabled unless you
narrow them with the X-MCP-Toolsets header or the --toolsets flag on a local run.
'default' selects the baseline below and 'all' turns on every toolset.
Toolset list checked against github/github-mcp-server README on 2026-09-06.
_available_toolsets_default: context     -- current user and repository context
repos       -- file contents, branches, commits, tags, releases
issues      -- read, create, update, comment on issues
pull_requests -- read, create, review, merge pull requests

local_alternative: Prefer the remote server above. To run the same server locally in a container,
replace the entry with the stdio form below (requires Docker):
security: Never put the token literally in this file. ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN} is
expanded from your environment when Claude Code reads .mcp.json.
Use a fine-grained token limited to the repos Claude needs.
If the variable is unset, Claude Code warns in /mcp and the server fails to connect.
verify: Run /mcp in Claude Code and confirm the server shows 'connected'.
A bad or missing token shows 'failed' with the HTTP status, usually 401.
